name: panda_pick_and_place_mjwarp_dense_v0
description: MuJoCo Menagerie Franka Panda pick-and-place benchmark with fixed-seed dense eval.
notes: The robot model is resolved from MuJoCo Menagerie through robot_descriptions, AUTORESEARCH_PANDA_MJCF, MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH, or .external/mujoco_menagerie.
Fixed eval success requires lift-before-place, so sliding the cube to the target does not solve the task; train-only subskill shaping belongs in the seed trainable.
